title: Bodycam: Dog Groomer Allegedly Punched Husky and Attacked Coworker
description:
A New Mexico dog groomer is unemployed after being fired for allegedly beating a furry customer and attacking a coworker on July 22. Rio Rancho authorities said Sheila Bacca called 911 and claimed another employee attacked her. When police arrived and reviewed surveillance footage, Bacca ended up being the person in handcuffs. Bacca was allegedly caught on camera being physical with a dog and hitting her coworker. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
